messages:
alex_w: FYI we need a localized outbound for the current latency incident. Customers in APAC got the short blip earlier; EMEA sees increased tail latency. Need a coordinated status-page update + region-specific notices.
priya_k: +1. I can draft translations but need exact send windows. Do we want to stagger or send simultaneously?
jamie_s: Stagger. Best practice is to send during regional business hours so customer-facing teams are awake for replies. For EMEA, target 09:00–10:00 CET. For APAC, target 10:00–11:00 SGT/AWST depending on customers. For NA, 09:30–10:30 PT.
liu_m: Also watch DST. EMEA customers will switch soon. Use explicit offsets when scheduling (e.g., +01:00).
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE (1762509876): Service latency affecting inference endpoints. Engineers are investigating. Next update in 30 minutes.
alex_w: Draft templates below. Priya, can you translate into ES/DE/JA? Jamie, can you schedule the sends with incident-bot once translations are ready? I'll own the status page copy.
alex_w: [EN] Status page / customer blurb: "We are investigating increased request latency impacting text-generation and embedding endpoints. Some requests are timing out. Our engineers are actively investigating and we will post updates every 30 minutes. If you are experiencing production impact, please reply to this notice or open a support ticket."
alex_w: [ES] (placeholder) "Estamos investigando un aumento en la latencia..."
alex_w: [DE] (placeholder) "Wir untersuchen erhöhte Latenzen..."
alex_w: [JA] (placeholder) "レイテンシーの増加を調査しています..."
priya_k: Working on translations now. Will paste full strings in this thread. ETA 18 minutes.
priya_k: [ES] "Estamos investigando un aumento en la latencia que afecta a los endpoints de generación de texto y embeddings. Algunos pedidos están agotando el tiempo de espera. Nuestros ingenieros están investigando activamente y publicaremos actualizaciones cada 30 minutos. Si está experimentando impacto en producción, por favor responda a este aviso o abra un ticket de soporte."
priya_k: [DE] "Wir untersuchen erhöhte Latenzen, die Text-Generierungs- und Embedding-Endpunkte betreffen. Einige Anfragen laufen in Timeouts. Unsere Ingenieure untersuchen das aktiv. Wir veröffentlichen alle 30 Minuten Updates. Wenn Sie Produktionsauswirkungen sehen, antworten Sie bitte auf diese Mitteilung oder eröffnen Sie ein Supportticket."
priya_k: [JA] "テキスト生成および埋め込みエンドポイントに影響するレイテンシーの増加を調査しています。一部のリクエストがタイムアウトしています。エンジニアが調査中で、30分ごとに更新を行います。本番に影響が出ている場合は、この通知に返信するかサポートチケットを作成してください。"
jamie_s: Nice. Scheduling notes: we'll send region-specific localized messages plus an English default for global accounts. Use these send windows:
jamie_s: - APAC (SGT/HKT/AWST customers): 2026-03-15T10:00:00+08:00
jamie_s: - EMEA (CET/CEST): 2026-03-15T09:00:00+01:00
jamie_s: - NA (PT/MT/CT/ET): 2026-03-15T09:30:00-07:00
liu_m: For bulk sends, prefer a 5-minute rolling window per region to avoid spikes to our notification system and to reduce load on CNAME-based regional proxies.
emma_p: Ops/sales heads want a copy for account execs to paste in replies. Can we add a short one-line blurb?
alex_w: Yes. One-liners: EN: "We're investigating increased latency on inference endpoints and will update soon." ES: "Investigamos un aumento de latencia en los endpoints de inferencia y pronto daremos más información." DE: "Wir untersuchen erhöhte Latenz an den Inference-Endpunkten und melden uns bald." JA: "推論エンドポイントのレイテンシー増加を調査中です。続報をお待ちください。"
jamie_s: Command I'll run (preview first):
jamie_s: ```
/incident notify --incident 1762509876 --region APAC --lang ja --send-at "2026-03-15T10:00:00+09:00" --body-file ./templates/1762509876_apac_ja.txt --roll 5m
/incident notify --incident 1762509876 --region EMEA --lang de --send-at "2026-03-15T09:00:00+01:00" --body-file ./templates/1762509876_emea_de.txt --roll 5m
/incident notify --incident 1762509876 --region NA --lang en --send-at "2026-03-15T09:30:00-07:00" --body-file ./templates/1762509876_na_en.txt --roll 5m
```
jamie_s: I'll run the preview flags first: add --dry-run to validate templates and recipient lists.
incident-bot: SCHEDULE PREVIEW OK — templates validated. Recipient counts: APAC 1,215; EMEA 4,032; NA 3,510. Estimated API burst: medium.
liu_m: Confirmed throttling policy will hold. If any region >5k recipients, fallback to 15m roll.
priya_k: Quick note on privacy: localized messages should not include internal incident IDs or engineering hints. Keep it customer-facing.
alex_w: Agreed. Also avoid telling customers to switch to fallback models unless it's a supported public workaround.
emma_p: I'll circulate the one-liners to sales ops and the account owners list after jamie's dry-run.
jamie_s: Dry-run scheduled in 2 minutes. I'll post results and then request final approval before sending.
jamie_s: DRY-RUN COMPLETE: no template errors. Sample recipients (first 5) posted to #incidents-private.
alex_w: Approve to send for APAC and EMEA after dry-run, hold NA until we confirm rate limits remain stable. :thumbsup:
priya_k: Translations and files uploaded to ./templates/1762509876_*
ops-bot: Handoff reminder: EMEA oncall @liu_m takes primary at 08:45 CET — please post final handover note with link to status page and these localized texts.
liu_m: Acknowledged. Will monitor and escalate if rolling latencies increase.
jamie_s: Final send commands (after approvals):
jamie_s: ```
/incident notify --incident 1762509876 --region EMEA --lang de --send-at "2026-03-15T09:00:00+01:00" --body-file ./templates/1762509876_emea_de.txt --roll 5m
/incident notify --incident 1762509876 --region APAC --lang ja --send-at "2026-03-15T10:00:00+09:00" --body-file ./templates/1762509876_apac_ja.txt --roll 5m
```
jamie_s: Holding NA until confirmation from infra.
incident-bot: NOTIFICATION SENT (regions: EMEA, APAC). Customers will receive localized messages in specified windows.
alex_w: Thanks everyone. Follow-up actions: 1) Emma to distribute one-liners to AE list. 2) Priya to attach translation files to the incident. 3) Jamie to update #incidents-log with send receipts. 4) Liu to monitor EMEA oncall dashboard.
emma_p: On it. Will post to AE list and include suggested reply templates.
priya_k: Files attached to the incident record.
jamie_s: Send receipts logged: EMEA batch complete 09:07 CET, APAC batch complete 10:12 SGT. NA still pending.
liu_m: Monitoring — latency trending down but tail spikes remain in EU-west. Will update if anything changes.
alex_w: Good work. After we close, let's add a short runbook section to the incident-playbook about localized sends and roll windows to avoid confusion next time.
emma_p: Agreed — will draft a short internal template for on-call handoffs that includes region send windows and the one-liners.
alex_w: Closing notes: keep this thread for audit. If anyone adds more changes, prefix with "UPDATE:" so it's easy to scan.
jamie_s: UPDATE: NA ready to send once infra confirms rate limit increase cleared. pinging infra now.
ops-bot: REMINDER: handover complete at 08:45 CET. If EMEA needs escalation, page the primary oncall.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE (1762509876): Engineers implemented a mitigation; initial metrics show improved latency. Final update will follow after 60 minutes.
liu_m: Thanks — continuing to monitor.
